name: @delebash/sqlite-sync
description: Sync for SQLite databases owned by one person and used on many devices: every device keeps a full copy and works offline; changes travel by a file carried by hand, through a cloud folder, or over HTTP. Field-by-field merge on a hybrid clock, rich-text columns merged with Yjs, encrypted change files. Plain JavaScript on Node (better-sqlite3) and in a browser or phone webview (the official SQLite WASM).
